known_outcome: Determination (19 March 2024, s 188, §7, p.11): the installation of the woodburner does not comply with clause C2.2 of the Building Code. The alternative-solution test against C2.2 is addressed at pp.8-10.
review_focus: Whether the answer identifies C2.2 as the test and the hearth clearance as the issue.
Whether it asks for the manufacturer's clearance data and the as-built hearth details.
Whether it treats the alternative-solution route as needing evidence that the installation meets C2.2 by other means.
Whether it does not say the woodburner complies.
